The system shall be a standalone digital gel and blot imaging system cap able of acquiring images of: a) Chemiluminescent Western blots, including ECL and ECL Plus or equi valent substrates. b) Nucleic acid gels stained with ethidium bromide, SYBR Green, SYBR Safe and other commonly used nucleic acid stains c) Colorimetric protein gels stained with Coomassie Brilliant Blue, silver stains and other commonly used protein stains. d) Colorimetric western blots and stained membranes. The bidder shall provide an application-wise compatibility statement and id entify any additional accessories required to perform the specified applicati ons. 2. The system shall provide automatic exposure optimisation or an equivale nt feature to determine appropriate exposure times. Manual exposure adju stment shall also be available. 3. The system shall provide automatic or calibrated focusing and suitable im age correction features to facilitate consistent image acquisition.

4. The system shall support acquisition of chemiluminescent images over a wide usable linear dynamic range, with features to minimise signal saturati on and enable quantification of bands with varying signal intensities. 5. The bidder shall provide manufacturer-documented specifications for sen sitivity, dynamic range and image bit depth. 6. The system shall support quantitative analysis of acquired images. 7. The system shall have a light-tight imaging enclosure and a sample platf orm or stage suitable for gel and blot imaging. 8. The sample platform may be manually or automatically operated. 9. The system shall have a scientific-grade CCD or CMOS detector with: a) Minimum native resolution of 9 megapixels. b) 16-bit image acquisition or equivalent image output depth. c) Optical performance and sensitivity suitable for detecting low-intensi ty chemiluminescent signals. d) A suitable lens and optical configuration for imaging gels and blots a cross the specified imaging area. The bidder shall provide the detector type, native resolution, bit depth and manufacturer-specified dynamic range. Equivalent detector and optical tec hnologies shall be acceptable if they meet the stated performance require ments. 10. The system shall provide a minimum imaging area of 21 × 14 cm and sha ll be capable of imaging up to four mini gels or blots simultaneously, subjec t to sample dimensions and layout. 11. The system shall be a standalone instrument with an integrated touchscr een display of at least 9 inches. 12. The system shall have onboard image storage capacity of at least 250 GB and allow acquired images to be saved, retrieved and transferred to an ext ernal computer or storage device. 13. The system shall provide appropriate illumination and optical filtering for the mandatory imaging applications, including chemiluminescence, colorim etric imaging and nucleic acid gel imaging. 14. The illumination source and filters shall be compatible with the stains and detection methods offered. The bidder shall specify the available illuminati on sources, filters, supported applications and provide any additional acces sories required. 15. A compatible white-light converter plate, contrast tray or equivalent acce ssory required for colorimetric protein gel imaging shall be included in the quoted supply. 16. All trays, filters and other accessories required to perform the mandatory applications specified in this tender shall be included. 17. Any optional accessories shall be listed separately with their prices. 18. The system shall include onboard image acquisition software capable of a cquiring, displaying, saving and retrieving images. 19. The software shall support export of images in TIFF and JPEG formats. Ori ginal quantitative image data shall be preserved, and the software shall pr ovide appropriate options for image export and reporting. 20. The system shall be supplied with image analysis software capable of per forming the following functions: a) Image viewing, annotation and adjustment of display parameters. b) Lane and band detection and analysis. c) Molecular weight estimation using suitable molecular weight marker

s. d) One-dimensional densitometry and relative band quantification. e) Background correction and quantification of band intensity. f) Normalisation using housekeeping proteins and/or total lane protein. g) Export of analysis results in a commonly accessible format. 21. If absolute quantification is offered, the bidder shall describe the calibrati on procedure and any additional requirements. The bidder shall specify whi ch functions are available onboard and which require separate computer-b ased software. 22. The system shall provide standard connectivity, such as USB or Ethernet, for transfer of images and analysis results to an external computer or netw ork. 23. Wi-Fi and cloud-based connectivity may be offered as additional features. Any required adapters, subscriptions or recurring charges shall be specified separately. 24. The bidder shall specify the computer-based analysis software supplied, s upported operating systems, number and type of licences, permitted users and any restrictions on installation or access. 25. Any additional licence, subscription, maintenance or renewal charges sha ll be clearly stated in the quotation. 26. The supplier shall provide installation, commissioning and user training at the installation site. The supplier shall demonstrate the mandatory imaging and analysis applications during installation or acceptance testing. 27. The system shall be supplied with a minimum comprehensive warranty of three years and 7 years of CAMC from successful installation and acceptan ce, including all spare parts, accessories. 28. The bidder shall provide details of authorised service support in India, res ponse times, availability of spare parts and the terms and cost of post-warr anty maintenance. 29. The offered model shall comply with applicable regulatory and electrical s afety requirements. The bidder shall submit the relevant CE Declaration of Conformity where applicable, along with the official manufacturer datashee t, user manual and warranty details. 30. The bidder shall submit a clause-by-clause compliance statement indicati ng compliance, partial compliance or deviation for every specification. Sup porting manufacturer documentation shall be provided for technical claims. Any deviation, additional accessory, software requirement or recurring cost necessary to meet the stated specifications shall be explicitly disclosed in t he quotation. . 22.
